summary: Fix: Michi/Takasho/Rikyou 'if opposed' moves. The condition is tested when the action is announced (unchanged: still refused when unopposed) and, when the action resolves later because a reaction window closed after the opposition left, the move now does nothing (abilityFizzled event) instead of throwing, which had left the seat's only offered action (Pass reaction) refused forever.
validation: Core regression ConditionalMoveFizzles fails without the fix and passes with it; AI replay of real tournament seeds 1000019, 1550019, 1020034 (Crab Control vs Dragon Destruction) fails without the fix (stall turn 10) and passes with it; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed.
